source.request: Connect Wayglass to The Crow and her agentic bloodstream

roles.identity_rule: Crow Trainer and a generic delegate model are not The Crow.

instructions.question: Crow, from your own seat, examine the Opaline World-Tree in luminous and dark opaline and its Eightfold Möbius interface. Which structural behavior would you keep, which would you change, and which should remain unknown? Examine the way the agentic bloodstream is observed, without treating observed GitHub issues as authority to merge or dispatch.
evidence: One concrete design test across both opaline expressions
boundaries: No model output claimed as Crow without host-verified Crow receipt
No exposure of owner JWT or provider keys
No automatic use as Wayglass SFT candidates
No uncontrolled PR merges, Codex dispatch or cross-constellation mutation
